original.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing. Create a polished marketplace product cover for the real Chinese SaaS “开物”. It must look like a credible software product, clean and premium with restrained technology styling that matches the actual site: charcoal/navy (#0d1521) background, blue (#3b70f8) accents, pale-white text, restrained soft blue edge glow, clean rounded panels. Square 1080x1080 or nearest square. Mobile-first composition with about 60px safe margins. Two-line bold simplified-Chinese title high on canvas and substantial real interface area below (at least 40%). No robot, stock people, cyberpunk city, invented 3D phone/device, fake dashboards, testimonials, revenue metrics, playback counters, QR codes, URLs, contact information, promises of results. Image 1 is a real historical interface screenshot supporting content: retain a faithful crop of its existing central/right function interface and upper content body in the design, keeping actual dark UI, shape, headings and paragraph appearance rather than redesigning the software. Exclude the top account/email strip and all customer profile names and customer identifiers. Do not display any email, real customer name, avatar profile info, original filename, soundtrack, admin content or video stats. The crop is for interface demonstration, not evidence of new output. Image 2 is the current public homepage brand reference: use the exact brand name 开物 and small square blue seal with 开, but do not include its whole feature brochure or statistical claims. It is reference only, not an edit target. Put a small clear label by the real UI area: “功能界面示意”. Do not invent generated outputs. Very readable Chinese; no extraneous copy. Text exactly as specified below. Price and period must be /月, never 30天.
Text (verbatim): brand “开物” with small “AI 编导工作台”; big title line1 “短视频选题” line2 “脚本 · 分镜”; subtitle “按客户背景，整理创作草稿”; price badge “专业会员 ¥99/月”; small bottom line “AI辅助创作，内容需核对”. Interface-area label “功能界面示意”. Make the price secondary to product benefit, prominent but tasteful. Keep the title very readable in a 180px thumbnail.
